CloseHandle.owner: HCU PS2 edge: file-bridge and EE-semaphore CloseHandle
CloseHandle.reason: Live callers close file-bridge slots, EE mutex semaphores, leftover find handles, and HaloAutoTest handles. The edge owner recognizes those tables and fails unknown pointers. CreateThread never produces a thread handle, so the missing thread case is not entered.

CopyFileA.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 0: XCreateSaveGame fail-closed rename path
CopyFileA.reason: The only live caller copies profile metadata after XCreateSaveGame returns zero. The batch contract returns ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, so the CopyFileA sites in synchronize_metadata_display_name_with_profile_name are not reached.

CreateDirectoryA.owner: HCU PS2 edge: read-only volume directory deny
CreateDirectoryA.reason: file_create and game_state_write_core treat a zero return as failure and do not invent a directory. The edge body returns 0 with ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED for a nonempty path.

CreateFileA.owner: HCU PS2 edge: GENERIC_READ OPEN_EXISTING file bridge
CreateFileA.reason: Tag-file reads use GENERIC_READ plus OPEN_EXISTING and receive a file-bridge handle. Write, create, and truncate modes return INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE. game_state_create_or_open_file already continues after a failed z:\savegame.bin open on HALO_PS2.

CreateMutexA.owner: HCU PS2 edge: EE binary semaphore mutex
CreateMutexA.reason: saved_game_files_initialize requires two successful create_mutex results. CE never OpenMutex-es the generated name; each create is a new EE semaphore used on the EE main thread.

CreateThread.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 0: no EE worker threads
CreateThread.reason: create_thread stores NULL and returns FALSE when CreateThread is NULL. Profile and playlist writers then skip the worker and keep memory-resident state. The adapter sets ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY instead of a bare generated NULL.

DeleteFileA.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 0: fail-closed writable Win32/XDK service
DeleteFileA.reason: delete_persistent_storage is the only live caller and ignores the return. A success-shaped delete would claim savegame.bin was removed from a volume this profile cannot write.

FindFirstFileA.reason: find_files_next treats INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE as no matches. find_files_globals.handles start as INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, so the first find_files_start does not close a live search handle.

FindNextFileA.reason: Reached only after a successful first match. The empty-volume first-match failure ends the loop; the body returns 0 with ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES if called.

GetExitCodeThread.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 0: no EE worker threads
GetExitCodeThread.reason: thread_has_exited is only entered with a non-NULL thread reference. CreateThread NULL keeps those references NULL, so the generated still-running failure is not observed.

GetFileAttributesA.reason: file_exists distinguishes missing paths via ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND. HaloAutoTest only opens state.data when d:\write.xts, read.xts, or loop.xts exist; missing attributes leave HATRun a no-op.

GetFileAttributesExA.owner: HCU PS2 edge: file-bridge GetFileAttributesExA size query
GetFileAttributesExA.reason: The live caller is file_get_size, which copies nFileSizeLow only. The edge body writes attributes and both size words on a successful stat.

GetFileSize.reason: file_get_eof reads the bridge size on a valid handle. The save-path caller only runs after a write CreateFileA, which the edge rejects.

GetLastError.owner: HCU PS2 edge: process-global last-error slot
GetLastError.reason: File facade and XInput diagnostics share one ps2_last_error. CreateThread never starts another EE thread, so the slot is equivalent to Win32 thread-local last-error for this profile.

GlobalMemoryStatus.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 0: EE physical GlobalMemoryStatus
GlobalMemoryStatus.reason: check_memory_status reads dwAvailPhys from an otherwise uninitialized MEMORYSTATUS. The generated empty body was undefined. The replacement writes every field from the 32 MiB EE map minus bound CE spans.

GlobalReAlloc.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 0: debug-header GlobalReAlloc
GlobalReAlloc.reason: system_realloc is only called from debug_realloc, which passes a 0x20-byte header whose user size is at offset 12 plus a 4-byte trailer. Copying min(old,new) prevents the previous unbounded new-size overread used by array growth.

ReadFile.reason: file_read requires bytes_read==count. The edge reader reports the actual count and fails invalid handles. Save and HaloAutoTest write handles are not created on this profile.

ReleaseMutex.owner: HCU PS2 edge: EE binary semaphore mutex
ReleaseMutex.reason: release_mutex signals the create-owned semaphore and ignores the Win32 return. Saved-game take/release pairs run on the EE main thread.

ResumeThread.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 0: no EE worker threads
ResumeThread.reason: create_thread calls ResumeThread only after CreateThread returns a handle and SetThreadPriority succeeds. The NULL CreateThread adapter keeps that path closed. The generated zero return is success-shaped and must not be approved as a resume.

SetEndOfFile.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 0: fail-closed writable Win32/XDK service
SetEndOfFile.reason: file_set_eof and the Xbox save initializers require a TRUE truncate. Write CreateFileA already fails, and the adapter reports ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED instead of a bare generated zero.

SetFilePointer.reason: Tag-file position helpers use BEGIN/CURRENT/END with no high dword, matching the edge seek. Save and HaloAutoTest write handles are not created.

SetLastError.owner: HCU PS2 edge: process-global last-error slot
SetLastError.reason: XInputOpen and the file facade write the same global slot GetLastError reads. No second EE thread exists under the CreateThread adapter.

SetThreadPriority.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 0: no EE worker threads
SetThreadPriority.reason: create_thread calls SetThreadPriority only on a non-NULL CreateThread handle. The NULL adapter keeps that path closed.

Sleep.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 0: EE bus-clock Sleep
Sleep.reason: main_loop Sleep(33-elapsed) and main_rasterizer_throttle Sleep(1) are live. The generated empty body busy-spins the EE. The replacement waits on GetTimerSystemTime using the same 147.456 MHz bus clock as GetTickCount.

SwitchToThread.reason: scenario_tags_load and scenario_structure_bsp_load poll while (!read_complete). ps2_cache.c sets the flag to _cache_file_read_failed (2) or TRUE (1) before return and never leaves 0, so the yield body does not run.

WaitForSingleObject.owner: HCU PS2 edge: EE binary semaphore mutex
WaitForSingleObject.reason: take_mutex accepts WAIT_OBJECT_0 from PollSema/WaitSema/WaitSemaEx on the create-owned semaphore. Saved-game locks are taken and released on the EE main thread.

WriteFile.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 0: fail-closed writable Win32/XDK service
WriteFile.reason: file_write requires a complete byte count. The generated FALSE did not set last-error. The adapter reports ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED and zero bytes written so a failed service is not mistaken for a short success.

XCalculateSignatureBegin.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 0: fail-closed writable Win32/XDK service
XCalculateSignatureBegin.reason: saved_game_file_generate_checksum treats any handle other than INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE as valid. The generated NULL would run Update/End. The adapter returns INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE.

XCalculateSignatureEnd.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 0: fail-closed writable Win32/XDK service
XCalculateSignatureEnd.reason: A zero return is success. The generated stub would finalize a checksum after a bogus handle. The adapter returns ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE.

XCalculateSignatureUpdate.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 0: fail-closed writable Win32/XDK service
XCalculateSignatureUpdate.reason: A zero return is success without hashing bytes. The adapter returns ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE.

XCreateSaveGame.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 0: fail-closed writable Win32/XDK service
XCreateSaveGame.reason: synchronize_metadata_display_name_with_profile_name treats zero as success and then copies files. The adapter returns ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED so the rename does not report a created save.

XDeleteSaveGame.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 0: fail-closed writable Win32/XDK service
XDeleteSaveGame.reason: Rename cleanup, delete_enumerated_saved_game_file, and saved_game_files_delete_all_custom_profiles treat zero as successful deletion. The generated zero would claim metadata was removed.
